title: CIA Confirms Role in 1953 Iran Coup (National Security Archive Electronic Briefing Book No. 435)
creator: National Security Archive, George Washington University (ed. Malcolm Byrne)
note: Posts declassified CIA documents incl. 'The Battle for Iran' (mid-1970s) and Wilber's 1954 Clandestine Services History. NSA states the release 'includes what is believed to be the CIA's first formal acknowledgement' of its role.
